title: Mizani
author: Somo team (XPRIZE Kenya)
description: At the market scale, add sacks to make both sides balance. Level 2: 5 + 3 = ? + 2. Level 3: take sacks away to balance.
description_sw: Kwenye mizani ya sokoni, ongeza magunia ili pande zote mbili zilingane. Kiwango 2: 5 + 3 = ? + 2. Kiwango 3: toa magunia kusawazisha.

lines.en: Tap the green button to start.
This is the market scale. Add sacks to the light side until both sides are the same. Then tap Check.
lines.sw: Hii ni mizani ya sokoni. Ongeza magunia upande mwepesi hadi pande zote mbili zilingane. Kisha gusa Angalia.

lines.en: Now find the number that makes both sides the same.
lines.sw: Sasa tafuta namba inayofanya pande zote mbili zilingane.

lines.en: Now take sacks AWAY from the heavy side to balance it.
lines.sw: Sasa ONDOA magunia upande mzito kuisawazisha.

lines.en: This side has {a}. That side has {b}. Add sacks to make them the same.
lines.sw: Upande huu una {a}. Ule una {b}. Ongeza magunia ili zilingane.

lines.en: {a} plus {b} is the same as what plus {c}?
lines.sw: {a} jumlisha {b} ni sawa na nini jumlisha {c}?

lines.en: This side has {a}. That side has {b}. Tap sacks on the heavy side to take them away.
lines.sw: Upande huu una {a}. Ule una {b}. Gusa magunia upande mzito kuyaondoa.

lines.en: Count both sides. Which side needs more?
lines.sw: Hesabu pande zote. Upande upi unahitaji zaidi?

lines.en: First add {a} and {b}. Then think: what plus {c} makes that?
lines.sw: Kwanza jumlisha {a} na {b}. Kisha fikiria: nini jumlisha {c} inafanya hivyo?

lines.en: {a} on one side, {b} on the other. {c} more makes them the same.
lines.sw: {a} upande mmoja, {b} upande mwingine. {c} zaidi zinazifanya zilingane.
